evidence.quote: Using a mixed-methods case study in a fintech organization, we analyze productivity and developers' perceptions of their professional roles.
We conducted a mixedmethods study over a three-month period, combining quantitative usage telemetry with qualitative thematic analysis of practitioner reflections within a 36-person technical unit.
Using deductive thematic coding aligned with the three DevEx dimensions (feedback loops, cognitive load, and flow state), we labeled each segment as positive, neutral, or negative.
This study was conducted in a Brazilian fintech organization (a fully online digital lender founded in 2015 that operates in both business-to-consumer and business-to-business markets)
This study examines the impact of AIassisted coding tools through a Developer Experience (DevEx) lens, investigating GitHub Copilot and Windsurf adoption in a fintech organization over three months.

We extracted: 1) the number of prompts (total prompts submitted to GitHub Copilot), 2) the number of suggestions (total code suggestions returned), 3) the acceptance rate by count (accepted suggestions/total suggestions)
Of the 36-person technical unit involved in the study, 26 participated in the meeting, and nine submitted in-depth reflections on their experiences with AI-assisted tools.
